name: otelcol.receiver.googlecloudpubsub

arguments.name: subscription
arguments.description: The subscription name to receive OTLP data from. The subscription name should be a fully qualified resource name, for example: projects/otel-project/subscriptions/otlp.

arguments.name: compression
arguments.description: The compression used on data received from the subscription. Only gzip is supported. This is only used when no content-encoding attribute is present.

arguments.name: encoding
arguments.description: The encoding used to receive data from the subscription. This can either be otlp_proto_trace, otlp_proto_metric, otlp_proto_log or an encoding extension. This is only used when no media type attribute is present.

arguments.name: endpoint
arguments.description: Override the default Pub/Sub endpoint. This is useful when connecting to the Pub/Sub emulator instance or switching between global and regional service endpoints.

arguments.name: ignore_encoding_error
arguments.description: Ignore errors when the configured encoder fails to decode Pub/Sub messages. Ignoring the error causes the receiver to drop the message.

arguments.name: insecure
arguments.description: Allows performing insecure SSL connections and transfers. This is useful when connecting to a local emulator instance. Only has effect if you set endpoint.

arguments.name: project
arguments.description: The Google Cloud Project project identifier.

arguments.name: timeout
arguments.description: Timeout for calls to the Pub/Sub API.

arguments.name: universe_domain
arguments.description: Universe domain for the Pub/Sub service. Set to support Sovereign Cloud regions.

blocks.description: Configures where to send received telemetry data.
Configures the metrics that this component generates to monitor its state.
